FN-27Z3KKS-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 1
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 01/30/2024
Senate Bill 1 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal
general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general fund,
municipal general fund, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase
the obligations of the State General Fund, local jails, the district attorneys, the Department of
Corrections, the Board of Pardons and Paroles, and community corrections programs by an
undetermined amount dependent on the number of persons charged with and convicted of the
offenses provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
Page 1
